name: 2026 Community Awards — Top Contributor Award
description: Issued to the ten most influential contributors officially selected by the Renaiss team.
howToEarn: Be selected by the Renaiss team as one of the ten most influential contributors during the designated evaluation period, based on overall contribution quality, influence, visibility, and impact across the community.

name: PSA 1
description: Issued to collectors who pulled a PSA 1 card from the Renacrypt Pack. Only 12 PSA 1 cards exist in total.
howToEarn: Pull a PSA 1 card from the Renacrypt Pack.

name: Renacrypt Epic Card
description: Awarded to collectors who pulled an Epic-tier card from the Renacrypt Pack.
howToEarn: Pull an Epic card from the Renacrypt Pack.

name: Beyond 10M
description: Issued to celebrate the milestone of Renaiss surpassing 10M in total platform trading volume. This SBT commemorates a key moment in the growth of the Renaiss ecosystem.
howToEarn: Be eligible during the campaign period when the platform officially surpasses 10M in total trading volume, subject to the rules and verification set by the Renaiss team.

name: Bless & Bust
description: Issued to participants of the Easter Pack drop as part of the Blessing and Bust event.

name: CEO Birthday
description: A badge for everyone who celebrated Winchman's birthday with us across X and Renaiss Discord.
howToEarn: Celebrate Winchman's birthday with Renaiss across X and Discord.

name: Community Developer
description: Awarded to developers who build applications, tools, or AI systems for Renaiss that support the on-chain lifecycle of physical collectibles — including on-chain representation, financialization, or liquidity. This badge recognizes meaningful technical contributions that extend Renaiss beyond the core platform.
howToEarn: Develop and submit an application, tool, or AI system supporting Renaiss, and be verified by the Renaiss team as an active and relevant contribution.

name: EASY Residency Signal
description: Issued to users who helped amplify EASY Residency's featured post about Renaiss.
howToEarn: Like, repost, and comment on EASY Residency's featured Renaiss post.

name: The Trader
description: Awarded to users who actively contribute to marketplace liquidity through consistent trading. Your activity helps build a healthy and dynamic economy in Renaiss.

name: Pack Opener
description: Awarded to users who consistently engage in pack opening, uncovering new cards and fueling ecosystem excitement.
